setup.title: Only you can see your photos
points: Photos are cleaned of location and device details on your phone, then encrypted.
Only encrypted data reaches the server. Neither we nor anyone with database access can open them.
The key is locked with a photo password you choose. The password never leaves your device.
setup.warning: If you lose both your password and the recovery code we give you, the photos cannot be opened again. Nobody can bring them back.
setup.hint: At least 10 characters. Use something different from your Google password.
setup.tooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
setup.rememberHint: When on, you are not asked for the password each time you open the app. Leave it off on shared devices.

recovery.title: Your recovery code
recovery.body: If you forget your password, only this code opens the album. It will not be shown again; save it in a password manager or on paper.
recovery.saved: I saved the code somewhere safe

unlock.title: Album locked
unlock.body: Enter your photo password to see your photos. It is only used on this device.
unlock.wrong: Wrong password. Try again or use your recovery code.

recover.title: Open with the recovery code
recover.body: Enter the code from setup and choose a new photo password.
recover.codeShape: The code has 32 characters (dashes and spaces do not matter).

gallery.empty: No photos yet. Your timeline starts here with the first one.
gallery.points: One photo a week earns 25 points.
gallery.decryptFail: This photo could not be opened.

add.title: Add photo
add.privacy: The photo is resized, stripped of location data and encrypted on your device; only encrypted data reaches the server.

compare.title: Compare
compare.needTwo: You need at least two photos in this pose to compare.

settings.title: Album settings
settings.rememberOn: This device keeps the album unlocked.
settings.rememberOff: This device does not remember the unlock.
